2. Short facts leading to this Rule are that on 15-3-1995 the pre-emptor (herein opposite party No.1), claiming to be a co-sharer tenant instituted Miscellaneous Case No. 11 of 1995 under section 96 of the State Acquisition & Tenancy Act, 1950, in the Court of Assistant Judge, Naogaon, for pre-emption of 0.56 acre of land out of 5.49 acres described in Police Station Atrai, Mouza Paharpur Bujruk, RS Khatian No. 171, transferred by vendors (herein opposite party Nos. 2-3) to pre-emptees (herein petitioners) at a consideration of Taka 3,000. 

 3. The pre-emptor's case, put in a nutshell, is that, he along with vendors and others are the co-sharer tenants of the holding described in RS Khatian No. 171; that the pre-emptees made an oral agreement with the vendors to purchase the land under pre-emption at a consideration of Taka 3,000; that with a view to defeat pre-emption, the vendors made an exchange of their 0.56 acres of land of Mouza Paharpur Burjuk (land under pre-emption) with the pre-ernptees of their 0.26 acres of land of the same Mouza vide exchange deed No. 1007 dated 27-2-1994; that subsequently, the vendors transferred the exchanged land to pre-emptees by a registered kabala deed No. 9145 dared 10-11-1994; that the pre-emptor came to know about such transfer on 29-1-1995 and filed the Miscellaneous Case for pre-emption on 15-3-1995. 

 10. Admittedly, the pre-emptor is the co-sharer tenant in the khatian under pre-emption, who claims that with a view to defeat pre-emption, the vendors made an exchange of their 0.56 acre of land of Mouza Paharpur Burjukpur (land under pre-emption) with the pre-emptees of their 0.26 acres of land of the same Mouza vide exchange deed No. 1007 dated 27-2-1994 and subsequently, the vendors transferred 0.23 acre of land vide registered kabala deed No. 9145 dated 15-11-1994 (Exhibit T) to the pre-emptees the pre-emptees disowned such facts. Its case was that the deed under pre-emption is exclusively an exchange deed, which is not pre-emptable under law. 

 11. On careful scrutiny of the exchange deed No. 1007 dated 27-2-1994 I find that the vendors (herein opposite party Nos. 1-3) as first party exchanged their 0.56 acre of land of Police Station Atrai Mouza Paharpur Burjuk of RS Khatian No. 171 with the pre-emptees as second party of their 0.26 acre ofland of the same mouza and possession was delivered to each other.
